description: Jiangxi University of Science and Technology researchers estimate permanent-resident population density across Henan Province, China, for 2020. The 200-metre grid combines night-time lights, points of interest, land cover and terrain using a Bayesian-optimised LightGBM model calibrated to township population. The repository reports comparisons with the seventh population census. ScienceDB offers the deposit free under CC BY 4.0, although the inspected metadata does not name the file format. Population in each cell is a modelled spatial allocation, not a direct household enumeration. It can provide demand or exposure weights for transport, utility and healthcare simulations, subject to checking population units and aggregation consistency. It complements data-copernicus-ghsl-built-up-population as a regional alternative with a different estimation method.
